subject: maths
question: A work was finished by L, P and Q together. L and P together finished 50 percent part of the work and P and Q together finished 60 percent part of the work. Who among the three is most efficient?
solution:
**Given:**

A work was finished by L, P and Q together.

L and P together finished 50 percent part of the work 

P and Q together finished 60 percent part of the work

**Calculation:**

L and P together finished, L + P = 0.5

Then Q does 1 - 0.5 = 0.5

P and Q together finished, P + Q = 0.6

Then P does 0.6 - 0.5 = 0.1

So, L does, 0.5 - 0.1 = 0.4

**∴ Among the three Q is most efficient**
